# Kintare soft fork 2.8.0

Based on upstream EML-Lib 2.7.3, commit 1350114806500481003dbd7c1ff323b0cb79ae4f.

- Add optional Kintare OIDC, profile, wardrobe and game-session clients with deployment-scoped discovery.
- Resolve Loki agents from GitHub Releases with verified caching and offline reuse.
- Add injectable HTTP transport and protected-profile access helpers for official EML AdminTool.
- Add optional file preservation, memory/Java configuration helpers and server-target parsing.
- Share concurrent updater operations and improve native extraction, Mojang rules and crash-log redaction.
- Preserve upstream exports, aliases, AdminTool routes and cleaning/cooldown defaults.
- Verify compatibility and the packed package before publication.
